site_name: Castle House, 37-45 Paul Street; and Fitzroy House, 13-17 Epworth Street and 1-15 Clere Street
evidence_slice: Islington Council states that its new Local Plan was adopted on 28 September 2023 and includes Site Allocations and the Bunhill and Clerkenwell Area Action Plan. The adopted BCAAP lists non-strategic allocation BC48 as Castle House, 37-45 Paul Street; and Fitzroy House, 13-17 Epworth Street and 1-15 Clere Street. Islington Planning Committee records that the site had been designated Site Allocation BC48, highlighting the opportunity to intensify office use, provide level access and create an active frontage. The official GLA-hosted Islington Site Allocations layer 41 is an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer in EPSG:27700; its data last edit date is 13 January 2025. Exact BC48 polygon extraction and canonical parcel spatial join are delegated to local OpenCode.
